title: Ostomy Supply Program Patient Balance, Adjustments, Refunds and Payment Plans
content:
The customer's balance on an Ostomy Supply Program enrollment is the running total of its patient-balance postings: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds add to it, and payments and balance adjustments reduce it. A payment is applied to the oldest unpaid posting first.

## 1. Balance adjustments

1.1 A balance adjustment is posted only for one of these reasons:

| Reason | What it covers |
|---|---|
| Return credit | An accepted self-pay return, for the price paid for the returned units less the tier's restocking fee percent |
| Secondary payer payment | The amount a secondary payer paid against a remittance's patient responsibility |
| Hardship waiver | A financial-hardship waiver under 1.3 |
| Small-balance write-off | Under 1.4 |
| Billing correction | A posting made in error, or a timely-filing write-off |

1.2 *Retired clause - no longer in force in its general form:* each adjustment is posted "each against the one posting it adjusts and never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder." It is superseded by the current basis: for the billing correction of an expedited shipping charge posted against a shipment Larkfield sent at its own cost, and only for such a correction, the adjustment is posted against that one charge and may exceed the charge by the service-recovery amount the Ostomy Supply Program's service-recovery correction rule states; every other balance adjustment is posted each against the one posting it adjusts and never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder.

1.3 A hardship waiver is granted only on tiers where a hardship waiver is allowed, only for postings named on a hardship application whose request status is approved, and only after Larkfield's financial counseling team confirms household income at or below the tier's hardship income ceiling percent of the HHS poverty guideline; it is never granted routinely, never advertised and never granted on the customer's statement alone.

1.4 A small-balance write-off is made only when the whole remaining balance of the program is greater than 0.00 and no more than the tier's small-balance ceiling; on tiers where that ceiling is 0.00 no write-off is made and the balance is statemented.

| Hypothetical remaining balance, ceiling USD 4.99 | Outcome |
|---|---|
| USD 4.99 | Written off |
| USD 5.00 | Statemented |
| USD 0.00 or a credit | No write-off |

## 2. Credit balances

A credit balance - a balance below zero - is refunded to the original payment method no later than the tier's credit-balance refund limit in calendar days after the posting date of the entry that created it, unless the customer asks in writing to keep it on account; a refund never exceeds the credit.

## 3. Payment plans

A payment plan is offered only on tiers where the longest payment plan term is greater than 0, for a balance of at least the tier's payment plan minimum balance, in no more than the tier's longest term of monthly installments of at least the tier's minimum installment. It is created as a payment plan request the customer accepts, and while an approved plan's installments are current, the balance it covers is left out of the past-due amount used for the shipment hold test.

superseded_clauses: each against the one posting it adjusts and never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder
